description: The plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layer groupings of a model. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer' and is a categorical scale with values 'Layer1-4', 'Layer5-12', 'Layer13-20', 'Layer21-28', and 'Layer29-32'. The y-axis is labeled 'Relative Change' and is a linear scale ranging from -30% to 5%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. A gray dashed line represents the baseline, remaining constant at 0% across all layer groupings. A yellow line, labeled 'LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit' and marked with circular data points, starts at approximately 0% at Layer1-4, decreases to -5% at Layer13-20, and returns to 0% at Layer29-32. A red line, labeled 'LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit' and marked with square data points, begins at approximately 0% at Layer1-4, decreases to -10% at Layer13-20, and returns to 0% at Layer29-32. A light blue line, labeled 'RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit' and marked with circular data points, starts at -2% at Layer1-4, decreases to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises to -2% at Layer29-32. A dark blue line, labeled 'RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit' and marked with square data points, begins at -4% at Layer1-4, decreases to -30% at Layer13-20, and rises to -5% at Layer29-32.
caption_used: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as the pruning method, are shown. The plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groupings, with the x-axis labeled 'Layer' and the y-axis labeled 'Relative Change'. The gray dashed line represents the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit, which remains constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) shows a steady trend, with a slight dip to approximately -5% at Layer13-20 before returning to 0%. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) follows a similar pattern, dipping to -10% at Layer13-20 and recovering to 0% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) starts at -2%, dips to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises back to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. Overall, the LB-Avg methods demonstrate more stability compared to the RULER4k methods, which exhibit sharper declines at intermediate layers.
